review_description: I purchased my Evnex E2 EV charger through the Evnex website and they arranged for Friend Electrical Solutions to complete the installation.Purchasing through the Evnex website was simple, with the final quote being negotiated over the phone with the local Evnex team. Even though they are a NZ company, they have staff in Australia and are always available to answer queries.The installation team arrived on time, were very courteous and completed the job to a high standard. I'm very happy with the install and the product has worked faultlessly since installation I highly recommend Friend Electrical Solutions and the Evnex E2 charger.
